title: UI shell and route scaffold
description: React + Vite shell with 6 routes, shared DashboardLayout + ThemeProvider + SceneCanvas, adapted useWakeLock and useFullscreen hooks (not auto-invoked).

requirements.title: Six navigable dashboard routes with correct data-theme
requirements.description: Router renders /mission-control, /hive, /forge, /ledger, /broadcast, /panorama; each has the correct data-theme attribute on its layout wrapper.

requirements.title: GapBadge + StaleBadge primitives
requirements.description: Gap and stale badge components surface availability status via data-testid markers for downstream automation.

requirements.title: Lazy SceneCanvas with Suspense fallback
requirements.description: SceneCanvas wraps R3F <Canvas> with a Suspense fallback so each route's scene module is code-split. Trivial cube is the shared placeholder for the 5 non-Mission-Control routes.

requirements.title: Adapted kiosk hooks, not auto-invoked
requirements.description: useWakeLock and useFullscreen live in ui/src/hooks but are not auto-invoked; kiosk-ux owns the policy layer.
